_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Ringsted (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Street/platform level: station building and platform 1 (track 1) on the station side; island perron 2 (tracks 2/3, partly 72 cm) and perron 3 (tracks 4/5)
levels.name_source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027 Bilag 3.6 + Banedanmark Open Data (platform register dk_register), read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/860000611).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 23 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000611).

1._source: Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts), Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 "Perronlængder og -højder" (table dated 1 August 2023), read 2026-10-30; TIB 1: tracks 1, class 55 cm = 0.55 m above rail, 321 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
